scene.context: Priya, the tech lead, has flagged the new auth PR two days before release.

antagonist_opening_line: Arjun, Priya here — three reviewers flagged the same token-refresh bug in your auth PR and release is in 48 hours.

strategy_chips.label: Own the bug now
strategy_chips.philosophy: Naming the problem first signals accountability and lowers the lead's anxiety.

strategy_chips.label: Reframe around release risk
strategy_chips.philosophy: Shifting to the shared release goal turns blame into joint problem-solving.

strategy_chips.label: Propose a 2-hour fix plan
strategy_chips.philosophy: A concrete timed plan buys space without looking evasive.

success_criteria: Asks one clarifying question about the failure
Commits to a specific next step and time

communication.what_good_looks_like: Clear, calm summary of the bug and its impact.

composure.what_good_looks_like: Stays steady under public criticism in standup.

clarity.what_good_looks_like: States exactly what will be fixed and by when.

strategy.what_good_looks_like: Chooses an approach that protects the release date.

outcome.what_good_looks_like: Lead agrees to the plan and moves standup on.
